back_translation: Wake up... and make your day just right ("mazboot").
notes: The English pun on grinding coffee and hustling is lost in Arabic, where "اطحن" reads as being crushed or worn down, so I swapped it for an Egyptian-colloquial play on "مظبوط", which means 'just right' and is also the classic medium-sugar Egyptian coffee order.
